subject: data associated to plot of MAF by pop

messages.author: 18e2562b97a9075c
messages.subject: data associated to plot of MAF by pop
parts:
Hello everyone,

I hope you're doing well. I recently used the 'gl.report.maf()' function to generate plots for both overall Minor Allele Frequency (MAF) and MAF by population. The function worked smoothly for creating these plots. However, I'm currently facing a challenge in retrieving the associated data, specifically for the overall MAF by locus and the MAF by population.

It seems that these MAF values are calculated within the function since they are displayed in the generated plots. I've also taken the time to check the Google group posts related to this issue, but unfortunately, I haven't come across a solution yet.

If anyone has any insights or suggestions on how to obtain the underlying MAF data, I would greatly appreciate your assistance.

Thank you in advance for your help!

Best regards,

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: data associated to plot of MAF by pop
parts:
Hi Cristian:

Try this:

library(dartR)
# overall MAF by locus in the entire dataset is here
platypus.gl$other$loc.metrics$maf
# MAF by population
# separating populations
sep_pop <- seppop(platypus.gl)
# getting summary stats by population
maf_sum <- lapply(sep_pop, function(x){
  x <- gl.recalc.metrics(x)
  summary(x$other$loc.metrics$maf)
})

Cheers,
Luis

Any guidance you can provide would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks again,

parts:
Hi Cristian,

You can try:

library(dartR)
# overall MAF by locus in the entire dataset is here
platypus.gl$other$loc.metrics$maf
# MAF by population
# separating populations
sep_pop <- seppop(platypus.gl)

# obtain each individual MAF value for every locus from each of these 'genlight' objects

  #recalculating metrics
  x <- gl.recalc.metrics(x)
})
# name of each population in maf_pop

# MAF by locus in pop 1

Cheers,
Luis
